question: Who was the Chairman of the Drafting Committee which had the task to prepare the draft of the Constitution?
solution:
The correct answer is **Dr. BR Ambedkar.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points:__**

__
 
• The Indian lawyer, economist, social reformer, and politician** Bhimrao Ramji Ambedkar** served as the chairman of the committee that created the** Indian Constitution **from the discussions in **the Constituent Assembly.**
 
• He also held the position of** Minister of Law and Justice in Jawaharlal Nehru's **first administration.
 
• After the **renunciation of Hinduism**, he became an inspiration for the **Dalit Buddhist movement.**
 
• After graduating from **Elphinstone College** at the **University of Bombay** and pursuing economic studies at **Columbia University **and the **London School of Economics, Ambedkar** became one of the few **Indians** to receive a **PhD** from a university in the 1920s.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information:__**

 
• The** Indian Constituent Assembly **was selected to draught the country's constitution.
 
• It was chosen by the **"Provincial Assembly."**
 
• Members of the "**Provisional Parliament of India**" functioned as the country's first Parliament after India earned independence from** British rule in 1947.**
 
• The idea of a **Constituent Assembly **was put up in December 1934 by **M. N. Roy,** an advocate of radical democracy and a significant figure in the **Indian Communist movement.**
 
• In 1935, the** Indian National Congress **made a formal demand for it.
